dedupe_keys.name: auckland council coastal inundation and coastal erosion susceptibility layers

description: Auckland Council publishes 30 coastal inundation layers (high water levels and inundation extents for return periods from 5 to 100 years, with and without 1 m and 2 m of sea-level rise) and 4 layers of the Area Susceptible to Coastal Instability and/or Erosion (ASCIE) for 2050, 2080 and 2130 under RCP8.5 scenarios. Coverage: the Auckland region coastline; layers were last modified between 2022 and 2026-09-25 according to the hub, and the ASCIE layers on 2024-09-18. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Auckland Council open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the layers are regional-scale hazard screening products; the description of the ASCIE layers gives the scenarios but no positional accuracy; the number of features and the exact model dates were not read. Simulation uses: coastal flood and erosion exposure of buildings, roads and utilities, sea-level-rise adaptation planning and scenario input for coastal infrastructure models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
